e12ddb0bzs4s0.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ejo8d29weetn.speaker: nekmax
ejo8d29weetn.text: From the 9th century to the early 15th century, the capital of the Khmer kings stood here, in and around this forest.
ejo8d29weetn.heard: From the 9th century to the early 15th century, the capital of the Khmer kings stood here, in and around this forest.

e1rxp60esu1rg.speaker: nekmax
e1rxp60esu1rg.text: First, let's go and see that capital. There's someone who can show us around!
e1rxp60esu1rg.heard: First, let's go and see that capital. There's someone who can show us around!
e1rxp60esu1rg.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1k373kwhtgar.speaker: narr
e1k373kwhtgar.text: 1296. The South Gate of Angkor Thom, the great capital.
e1k373kwhtgar.heard: The South Gate of Angkor Thom, the great capital.
e1k373kwhtgar.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e11tiac1prkz.speaker: narr
e11tiac1prkz.text: On both sides of the bridge over the moat stood long rows of stone gods. Together, they held the body of a huge snake, like a rope.
e11tiac1prkz.heard: On both sides of the bridge over the moat stood long rows of stone gods. Together, they held the body of a huge snake, like a rope.

e196tr1r20epr.speaker: narr
e196tr1r20epr.text: Above the gate were great faces. The one in the middle was decorated with gold and shone in the morning sun.
e196tr1r20epr.heard: Above the gate were great faces. The one in the middle was decorated with gold and shone
e196tr1r20epr.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e7nqa0slx55f.speaker: narr
e7nqa0slx55f.text: At the foot of the bridge, a young man in a blue robe was busily writing on paper with a brush.
e7nqa0slx55f.heard: At the foot of the bridge, a young man in a blue robe was busily writing on paper with a brush.
e7nqa0slx55f.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e4st2kz10jhl.speaker: zhou
e4st2kz10jhl.text: …Oh, my. You have come from far away too, haven't you? I can tell from the dust on your feet.
e4st2kz10jhl.heard: Oh, my. You have come from far away too, haven't you? I can tell from the dust on your feet.
e4st2kz10jhl.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e8ph2isz74o8.speaker: zhou
e8ph2isz74o8.text: My name is Zhou Daguan. I am one of a group of envoys from a country across the sea called Yuan.
e8ph2isz74o8.heard: My name is Zhou Daguan. I am one of a group of envoys from a country across the sea called Yuan.
e8ph2isz74o8.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

emv860ii2ye2.speaker: zhou
emv860ii2ye2.text: We reached this capital at the end of summer. I mean to write down everything I see.
emv860ii2ye2.heard: We reached this capital at the end of summer. I mean to write down everything I see.
emv860ii2ye2.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e10o0fbe1b4m0.speaker: zhou
e10o0fbe1b4m0.text: Oh, it's you! How good to meet you again.
e10o0fbe1b4m0.heard: Oh, it's you! How good to meet you again.
e10o0fbe1b4m0.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1l34zmw1uus7.speaker: zhou
e1l34zmw1uus7.text: …Oh, my. You have come from far away too, haven't you? …But why do you look at me as if you know me?
e1l34zmw1uus7.heard: Oh, my. You have come from far away too, haven't you? …But why do you look at me as if you know me?
e1l34zmw1uus7.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

esnxsqc3b0gu.speaker: zhou

en4mhct1siij.speaker: nekmax
en4mhct1siij.text: I'll translate what Zhou Daguan says for you. …He was a real person! A traveler who came here 700 years before us.
en4mhct1siij.heard: I'll translate what Zhou Daguan says for you. …He was a real person! A traveler who came here 700 years before us.
en4mhct1siij.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1yg00o51gakb.speaker: zhou
e1yg00o51gakb.text: Look. On each side of the bridge stand fifty-four stone gods. Together, they hold a snake with nine heads.
e1yg00o51gakb.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ed32r3b1imfx.speaker: zhou
ed32r3b1imfx.text: On either side of the gate are stone elephants. The gate opens in the daytime and closes at night. There are even guards to watch over it.
ed32r3b1imfx.heard: On either side of the gate are stone elephants. The gate opens in the daytime and closes at night. There are even guards to watch over it.
ed32r3b1imfx.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1ebybo71u21z.speaker: zhou
e1ebybo71u21z.text: And in the very center of the capital stands a golden tower.
e1ebybo71u21z.heard: And in the very center of the capital stands a golden tower.
e1ebybo71u21z.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1pk8sh611nap.speaker: nekmax
e1pk8sh611nap.text: The golden tower is the Bayon. By the time Zhou Daguan came, it had already been standing for almost 100 years.
e1pk8sh611nap.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

eej3tob1mxir.speaker: zhou
eej3tob1mxir.text: Then there is the market. In this country, it is the women who are good at trading.
eej3tob1mxir.heard: Then there is the market. In this country, it is the women who are good at trading.
eej3tob1mxir.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1uqdztxcyi88.speaker: zhou
e1uqdztxcyi88.text: There are no shops. People spread mats on the ground and sell from them. I hear each seller has her own place.
e1uqdztxcyi88.heard: There are no shops. People spread mats on the ground and sell from them. I hear each seller has her own place.
e1uqdztxcyi88.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e12e0grx1wuya.speaker: nekmax
e12e0grx1wuya.text: (whispering) …That's just how Chanthy's mother did it, too.
e12e0grx1wuya.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ef5lsr1rjwy.speaker: zhou
ef5lsr1rjwy.text: By the way, tonight is the festival for the start of the new year. Would you like to come and see it with me?
ef5lsr1rjwy.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

eucilhl1lwvl.speaker: narr
eucilhl1lwvl.text: Night. In the square in front of the royal palace, a large stage had been built and decorated with lights and flowers.
eucilhl1lwvl.heard: Night. In the square in front of the royal palace, a large stage had been built and decorated with lights and flowers.
eucilhl1lwvl.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

e1y2zayncl12y.speaker: narr
e1y2zayncl12y.text: From a very, very tall bamboo frame, a ball of fire went whooshing up into the night sky.
e1y2zayncl12y.heard: From a very, very tall bamboo frame, a ball of fire went whooshing up into the night
e1y2zayncl12y.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

e12v3zzz1ywf4.speaker: narr
e12v3zzz1ywf4.text: Boom! The sound seemed to shake the whole capital.
e12v3zzz1ywf4.heard: The sound seemed to shake the whole capital.
e12v3zzz1ywf4.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

evpllu51kd66.speaker: zhou
evpllu51kd66.text: They say these fires can be seen from a hundred li away — very far indeed. And the festival goes on for fifteen whole days.
evpllu51kd66.heard: They say these fires can be seen from a hundred li away — very far indeed. And the festival goes on for fifteen whole days.
evpllu51kd66.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

ee94gri17re9.speaker: zhou
ee94gri17re9.text: …Traveler. If it were you, what would you write down about this journey?
ee94gri17re9.heard: If it were you, what would you write down about this journey?
ee94gri17re9.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

e1un8iv11lqt2.speaker: zhou
e1un8iv11lqt2.text: Just like me, then. What you see, just as you see it. That is what lasts the longest.
e1un8iv11lqt2.heard: What you see, just as you see it. That is what lasts the longest.
e1un8iv11lqt2.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

e57v0zc1lvo5.speaker: zhou
e57v0zc1lvo5.text: About people? …How fine. People are forgotten far sooner than stone towers, after all.
e57v0zc1lvo5.heard: How fine. People are forgotten far sooner than stone towers, after all.
e57v0zc1lvo5.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

e1glkdlpwhis6.speaker: zhou
e1glkdlpwhis6.text: Ha ha ha. That is a traveler's wisdom, too. I have not seen even half of it myself yet.
e1glkdlpwhis6.heard: Ha ha ha. That is a traveler's wisdom, too. I have not seen even half of it myself yet.
e1glkdlpwhis6.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

e1j9q4l711oqe.speaker: zhou
e1j9q4l711oqe.text: Well then, I shall go and write a little more. Until we meet again, in some other time.
e1j9q4l711oqe.heard: Well then, I shall go and write a little more. Until we meet again, in some other time.
